summary: Ford Motor Co filed an 8-K to report second quarter 2026 U.S. sales results via a press release. The filing is a routine operational update without any special-situation event. It discloses sales figures for F-Series, Maverick, Bronco, Mustang, and Lincoln models, plus Ford Pro subscription growth. There are no M&A terms, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, capital return, restructuring, or other special-situation triggers. The filing is purely informational under Item 8.01 and therefore does not qualify for a special-situations classification.
